newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aero denies share placement talk.
newsitem.headline: China Aero denies share placement talk.

text.p: China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd denied reports it was engaged in discussions to arrange a share placement.
"There has not been any discussion nor plan for placing shares by the company at the moment," China Aero said in a statement on Fridayy.

According to the statement, the company was rumoured to be planning to raise funds through a share placement to finance a Jiangsu Province Cable Television Project and to finance expansion of its investment in the automobile business.
